name: WHIPLASH
description:
About This Game

The right gear makes all the difference. Choose weapons, modules, and utility items to clear each course as quickly as possible. Every course challenges you to rethink your route, your loadout, and your strategy. Combine Weapon Modules to create powerful builds that change how your guns perform.

Compete on Global, National, and Friends leaderboards, and move up with each Personal Best. Compare loadouts with other players, take on Daily and Monthly courses, and keep pushing for better times. Whether you are chasing the top spot or racing your friends, WHIPLASH gives you meaningful competition at every skill level.

The Corps is a military superpower on the cutting edge of robotic warfare. Their flagship soldiers, REAPERS, are trained through countless combat scenarios and gear configurations. Each course pushes REAPERS to move faster, fight smarter, and adapt to whatever equipment is available.

You are a REAPER programmed to complete the training by any means necessary. Master the courses, optimize your loadout, and prove you are the most efficient soldier in the program.

Additional Features

  • Randomized Maps - Seed-based course layouts with Daily and Monthly challenges.

  • Progression - Unlock new maps, weapons, and items through the Campaign.

  • Unlockables - Earn skins, portraits, music, and more.

  • Original Soundtrack - Build your own in-game playlist or set it to shuffle.
short_desc: WHIPLASH is a speedrunning FPS where game-changing weapon mods turn ordinary guns into overpowered builds. Craft the perfect loadout, master each course, and chase the perfect run.
